basic_details.short_information: Digital India Corporation (DIC) has 1 post of Senior Manager – Government Partnerships & Business Development, offered purely on a Contract/ Consolidated basis with posting in Noida or New Delhi. DIC is a not-for-profit company set up by the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, Government of India. Applicants need a graduate degree in any discipline and a minimum of 12–16 years of relevant professional experience, and the consolidated remuneration is commensurate with qualifications and experience. how_to_apply: Eligible candidates may apply online on the DIC recruitment portal, ora.digitalindiacorporation.in. Applications must be received by 29 October 2026. The details of the advertisement can be downloaded from www.dic.gov.in, www.negd.gov.in, www.mygov.in and www.meity.gov.in.

No Objection Certificate (only for candidates already in regular or contractual employment under the Central or State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies): these candidates are expected to apply through proper channel or attach a No Objection Certificate from their employer with the application, or produce the No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.
important_instructions: DIC reserves the right to fill all, some or none of the advertised positions, and not to fill the post, without giving any reason. Candidates must disclose any actual or potential conflict of interest with Digital India Corporation or its projects. The selected candidate must furnish an Integrity and Vigilance Declaration and maintain the highest standards of ethics. Appointment is subject to verification of educational qualifications, previous employment, antecedents and character. If any information a candidate gives is found false or suppressed at any stage, the candidature or appointment will be cancelled without notice. Personal information will be processed only for recruitment purposes, in accordance with applicable laws. Digital India Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. For queries, candidates may contact Ms. Vinaya Viswanathan, Head- HR, Digital India Corporation, Electronics Niketan Annexe, 6 CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003, Tel.: +91 120 654 0800.

content_sections.heading: About DIC
content_sections.text: Digital India Corporation was set up by the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, Government of India, to innovate, develop and deploy ICT and other emerging technologies for the benefit of the common man. It is a "not for profit" company under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013, and has been leading the Digital India programme, including the use of technology for e-Governance, e-Health/Telemedicine, e-agriculture and e-Payments. Its office is at Electronics Niketan Annexe, 6, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognised university. A postgraduate qualification in Management, Business Administration, Public Policy, Public Administration or a related field will be an added advantage. Experience (essential): Minimum 12–16 years of relevant professional experience, including substantial experience in government relations, public-sector business development, institutional partnerships, government consulting or client acquisition. Demonstrated experience in engaging with Central or State Government departments, public sector institutions or autonomous government bodies. Experience in proposal development, Expressions of Interest, tender or RFP responses, partnership development and bid coordination. Experience in coordinating with multidisciplinary teams for the preparation and submission of proposals and business documents. Key competencies: Strong government and institutional networking capabilities. Business development, negotiation and relationship management. Proposal writing, bid coordination and presentation skills. Strategic thinking, stakeholder management and communication. Ability to work independently and drive business opportunities from initial engagement to proposal submission and follow-up. Age: The maximum age is reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications (29 October 2026). The notice does not print the age limit itself. Any candidate found debarred, blacklisted or convicted of offences involving moral turpitude is not eligible. For the full eligibility of the post, see the official notification. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is commensurate with qualifications and experience, within the approved project norms. The notice does not print a fixed amount. The position is purely temporary, for the project of Digital India Corporation. The appointee will have no right or claim to a permanent appointment at DIC, or to any vacancy that exists now or that DIC advertises in future. The selected candidate's designation will be mapped as per DIC's existing designation policy. The place of posting will be Noida or New Delhi. The post is transferable to DIC's project locations as per DIC's existing policy.

content_sections.heading: DIC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Role overview: The Senior Manager will lead engagement with Central and State Government departments, public sector institutions and strategic partners to identify and develop business opportunities for the organisation. The role covers institutional outreach, partnership development, opportunity assessment, proposal and bid coordination, client relationship management, and turning qualified opportunities into lasting engagements. Build and maintain working relationships with Central and State Government Ministries, departments, public sector undertakings, autonomous bodies and other government institutions. Facilitate engagement with senior government officials, institutional stakeholders and prospective clients. Represent the organisation at government meetings, conferences, consultations, industry forums and stakeholder interactions. Identify areas where the organisation's capabilities may support government programmes, initiatives and institutional requirements. Identify, develop and manage strategic partnerships with government bodies, public institutions, industry partners, development organisations and other stakeholders. Explore joint initiatives, consortium arrangements, Memoranda of Understanding and other institutional collaborations. Identify suitable technical, implementation and consortium partners for specific opportunities. Maintain a network of institutional and strategic partners to expand the organisation's reach and access to new business opportunities. Identify and pursue business opportunities aligned with the organisation's objectives, particularly within the government and public sector ecosystem. Undertake client outreach, institutional networking and relationship management to generate qualified leads and build a sustainable business pipeline. Assess prospective opportunities with internal teams, considering organisational capability, strategic relevance, eligibility requirements, resource availability and commercial viability. Maintain an updated opportunity pipeline and report progress, risks and required interventions to senior management at regular intervals. Lead and coordinate the preparation of concept notes, Expressions of Interest, proposals, bids, presentations and other business-development documents. Coordinate with technical, finance, legal, procurement and other teams to develop complete and competitive responses to government and institutional requirements. Support bid strategy, partner identification, technical-commercial documentation, client presentations and follow-up. Ensure that proposals and bid submissions are completed accurately and within the prescribed timelines. Follow up with prospective clients and partners to move opportunities from initial engagement to proposal submission and business closure. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: Applications are shortlisted through an objective evaluation matrix based on educational qualification, relevant experience, domain expertise, certifications, publications and other criteria approved by the Competent Authority. Screening of applications will be based on qualifications, age, academic record and relevant experience. Meeting the eligibility conditions alone does not give a right to be shortlisted. DIC reserves the right to fix a higher threshold of qualifications and experience to screen candidates and limit the number called for interview. DIC's decision on shortlisting is final and binding. Interview: Only shortlisted candidates will be invited for selection interviews. Selection: Selection will be made by a duly constituted Selection Committee approved by the Competent Authority of DIC.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DIC Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. DIC /10/2026/22) has 1 vacancy, for the post of Senior Manager – Government Partnerships & Business Development.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DIC Senior Manager post?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the DIC Senior Manager – Government Partnerships & Business Development post?
faq.answer: Applicants need a graduate degree in any discipline from a recognised university. A postgraduate qualification in Management, Business Administration, Public Policy, Public Administration or a related field will be an added advantage.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is needed for the DIC Senior Manager post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a minimum of 12–16 years of relevant professional experience, including substantial experience in government relations, public-sector business development, institutional partnerships, government consulting or client acquisition.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the DIC Senior Manager post?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated remuneration that is commensurate with qualifications and experience, within the approved project norms.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for DIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates may apply online on the DIC recruitment portal, ora.digitalindiacorporation.in, by 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for DIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted through an objective evaluation matrix, and only shortlisted candidates are invited for selection interviews. The final selection is made by a duly constituted Selection Committee approved by the Competent Authority of DIC.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DIC Senior Manager post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary, on a Contract/ Consolidated basis for the project of Digital India Corporation, and the appointee will have no right or claim to a permanent appointment at DIC.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the DIC Senior Manager be posted?
faq.answer: The place of posting will be Noida or New Delhi. The post is transferable to DIC's project locations as per DIC's existing policy.

faq.question: Q10. Do government employees need a No Objection Certificate to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates already in regular or contractual employment under the Central or State Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies should apply through proper channel or attach a No Objection Certificate with the application, or produce it at the time of interview.
